title: XGUARD: A Graded Benchmark for Evaluating Safety Failures of Large Language Models on Extremist Content
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the safety of LLMs specifically regarding extremist and terrorist content. While the dataset includes religious leaders as actors and religious radicalization as a scenario, these are used as variables for prompt generation in the context of safety benchmarking rather than as a core evaluation of religious faith, theology, or general ethics.
